sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", container!="", pod=~".*proxy.*"}) by (pod) / sum(container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{namespace="$namespace", container!="", pod=~".*proxy.*"}) by (pod)

panels.description: Number of times each Ogmios instance's chain tip (ogmios_tip_slot) advanced in the last 15 minutes. A value of 0 can help diagnose a frozen tip; the alert compares each pod's tip with the freshest Cardano node tip on its network.
panels.title: Tip Slot Advancement (changes / 15m)
